title: Gloria (Palestrina, Missa Nigra sum)
desc: Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina, Missa Nigra sum, Gloria. 5 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor primus, Tenors secundus, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
